title: Edit a draft quote
summary: Change the items, prices or details of a quote that hasn't been confirmed yet.

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Purchase Quotes
steps.details: A provider's quote: which products or services, at what price. Once confirmed, it's invoiced when received.

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.details: Tap the quote in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Edit
steps.details: Only drafts can be edited; a confirmed quote no longer changes.

steps.title: Items
steps.details: Add, remove or change quantities and prices.
